Clarkson University is a national research hub for leading STEM innovation. We foster an entrepreneurial mindset by connecting hands-on learning, breakthrough research, and a powerful industry and alumni network.

As a top-tier STEM university, we’re dedicated to creating graduates who are ready to work, as reflected in our 98% placement rate. Our alumni network of over 48,000 ranks in the top 2% nationally for salaries, with one in five already leading as a CEO, senior executive, or business owner.

Located in Potsdam, N.Y., our campus is surrounded by the great outdoors. We offer over 90 rigorous programs in engineering, business, sciences, and health professions.

Ready to see where a Clarkson education can take you? 
Visit www.clarkson.edu to learn more.
